issue.title: Make sase repo list honor the current workspace's repo config
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-l2.2 while verifying the sase-research-artifacts rename before its SASE wiring commit landed. Reproduction: from a numbered workspace with an uncommitted edit to sase/sase.yml repos.linked, running sase repo list --json still renders the linked rows from the registered primary checkout, so it showed the old sase-research row rather than the workspace-local sase-research-artifacts row. Root cause confirmed on current master: src/sase/main/repo_handler_list.py resolves a ProjectContext for cwd, but then calls collect_repo_inventory(project=ctx.project_name); src/sase/repo_inventory.py rebuilds that project's entries from ProjectSpec WORKSPACE_DIR and read_project_local_config(primary), discarding the current checkout path. Impact: the command's documented current-project/current-workspace default cannot validate repo-config changes before they land. Scope the fix to make current-checkout invocation read the current workspace's config while preserving explicit --project/--all behavior, clone-matrix semantics, and repo open/path consistency; add CLI/inventory regression coverage.

payload.close_reason: Duplicate: sase-l2.land filed this same repo-list follow-up twice within 43 seconds (sase-l4 at 15:16:01, sase-l5 at 15:16:44) with identical titles, reproductions, and root-cause analysis. sase-l5 is the surviving READY bead; closing this draft so only one triage gate remains.
